title: Settle shell, system skeletons, faster tabs
summary: Print & Pay settles on one card with a live skeleton, main screens show loading skeletons instead of hanging, and tab switches paint first so the cursor no longer freezes 2–3s. Desktop content updater also gets automatic version bumps on every deploy.
highlights: Print & Pay: Settling… + same-card morph into Bill settled (no blank hang)
RSSkel loading shapes on Bills, Kitchen, QR, Floor, Inventory, Menu, Reports, Customers
Tab switch paints immediately, then loads modules — no frozen hand cursor
Single shared cart path (no dual empty-cart Print & Pay bug)
Every production deploy auto-bumps content version so installed EXE can pull UI updates
